description: This header file defines the Abseil hash library and framework, including the Hash functor, HashState class, and support for adding custom hash support via AbslHashValue. It provides mechanisms for hashing various types, managing hash states, and extending hashing capabilities for user-defined types.

classes.name: HashState
classes.description: A type-erased class implementing hash state manipulation, supporting combining hash values, contiguous data, and unordered collections.

methods.name: HashState::Create
methods.description: Creates a HashState instance that wraps an existing hash state object, allowing type erasure.

methods.name: HashState::combine
methods.description: Combines multiple values into the hash state.

methods.name: HashState::combine_contiguous
methods.description: Combines a contiguous array of bytes into the hash state.
